ud4.5:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
ud4.5:1.3: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā ākiṇṇo viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi rājūhi rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi
ud4.5:1.6: ahaṃ kho etarahi ākiṇṇo viharāmi bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi rājūhi rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi
ud4.5:2.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya kosambiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
ud4.5:2.2: kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto sāmaṃ senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaramādāya anāmantetvā upaṭṭhākaṃ anapaloketvā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ eko adutiyo yena pālileyyakaṃ tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi
ud4.5:2.4: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā pālileyyake viharati rakkhitavanasaṇḍe bhaddasālamūle.
ud4.5:3.1: aññataropi kho hatthināgo ākiṇṇo viharati hatthīhi hatthinīhi hatthikuḷabhehi hatthichāpehi chinnaggāni ceva tiṇāni khādati obhaggobhaggañcassa sākhābhaṅgaṃ khādanti āvilāni ca pānīyāni pivati ogāhā cassa uttiṇṇassa hatthiniyo kāyaṃ upanighaṃsantiyo gacchanti
ud4.5:3.4: ahaṃ kho etarahi ākiṇṇo viharāmi hatthīhi hatthinīhi hatthikuḷabhehi hatthichāpehi chinnaggāni ceva tiṇāni khādāmi obhaggobhaggañca me sākhābhaṅgaṃ khādanti āvilāni ca pānīyāni pivāmi ogāhā ca me uttiṇṇassa hatthiniyo kāyaṃ upanighaṃsantiyo gacchanti ākiṇṇo dukkhaṃ na phāsu viharāmi
ud4.5:4.1: atha kho so hatthināgo yūthā apakkamma yena pālileyyakaṃ rakkhitavanasaṇḍo bhaddasālamūlaṃ yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā
ud4.5:4.2: tatra sudaṃ so hatthināgo yasmiṃ padese bhagavā viharati taṃ padesaṃ apaharitañca karoti soṇḍāya bhagavato pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ upaṭṭhapeti.
ud4.5:5.1: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
ud4.5:5.2: ahaṃ kho pubbe ākiṇṇo vihāsiṃ bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi rājūhi rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi ākiṇṇo dukkhaṃ na phāsu vihāsiṃ
ud4.5:5.3: somhi etarahi anākiṇṇo viharāmi bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi rājūhi rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi anākiṇṇo sukhaṃ phāsu viharāmīti.
ud4.5:6.1: tassa kho hatthināgassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
ud4.5:6.2: ahaṃ kho pubbe ākiṇṇo vihāsiṃ hatthīhi hatthinīhi hatthikuḷabhehi hatthichāpehi chinnaggāni ceva tiṇāni khādiṃ obhaggobhaggañca me khādiṃsu āvilāni ca pānīyāni piviṃ ogāhā ca me uttiṇṇassa hatthiniyo kāyaṃ upanighaṃsantiyo aggamaṃsu ākiṇṇo dukkhaṃ na phāsu vihāsiṃ
ud4.5:6.3: somhi etarahi anākiṇṇo viharāmi hatthīhi hatthinīhi hatthikuḷabhehi hatthichāpehi acchinnaggāni ceva tiṇāni khādāmi obhaggobhaggañca me sākhābhaṅgaṃ na khādanti anāvilāni ca pāniyāni pivāmi ogāhā ca me uttiṇṇassa na hatthiniyo kāyaṃ upanighaṃsantiyo gacchanti anākiṇṇo sukhaṃ phāsu viharāmīti.
ud4.5:7.1: atha kho bhagavā attano ca pavivekaṃ viditvā tassa ca hatthināgassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi
